title: Alphabet Kicks Off Aussie Dollar Bond Sale as AI Spending Soars
title_zh: 随着人工智能支出飙升，Alphabet 启动澳元债券发售
summary: Alphabet Inc. started marketing its debut Australian debt offering as the US tech giant targets its latest multi-billion dollar fundraising, with AI spending skyrocketing.
summary_zh: Alphabet Inc. 开始营销其首次澳大利亚债券发行，这家美国科技巨头瞄准了最新的数十亿美元融资目标，人工智能支出飙升。

title: Meta Stares Down Trillion-Dollar Threat as Landmark Social Media Trial Begins
title_zh: 随着具有里程碑意义的社交媒体审判开始，Meta 着眼于数万亿美元的威胁
summary: Meta Platforms Inc. is headed to court Tuesday for a high-stakes showdown with a coalition of state attorneys general over claims that the company deliberately designed Facebook and Instagram to encourage compulsive use among young users.
summary_zh: Meta Platforms Inc. 将于周二与州检察长联盟进行一场高风险的法庭对决，指控该公司故意设计 Facebook 和 Instagram 来鼓励年轻用户强迫性使用。

title: Amazon Alexa+ assistance is the way consumers 'actually want to shop': VP
title_zh: 亚马逊 Alexa+ 协助是消费者“真正想要购物”的方式：副总裁
summary: Amazon (AMZN) vice president of Alexa and Echo, Daniel Rausch, speaks with Josh Lipton about all the ways the new Alexa+ engages with shoppers through its enhanced personal assistant functions.
summary_zh: 亚马逊 (AMZN) Alexa 和 Echo 副总裁 Daniel Rausch 与 Josh Lipton 讨论了新 Alexa+ 通过其增强的个人助理功能与购物者互动的所有方式。

title: Tesla prepares for Cybercab launch in August starting with rides to employees, the Information reports
title_zh: 据《Information》报道，特斯拉准备在 8 月份推出 Cyber​​cab，首先为员工提供乘车服务
summary: Tesla has told employees it is gearing up for a public launch ‌of Cybercab, starting with a rollout in ‌Austin, Texas, as soon as this month, the Information reported on ​Monday, citing people with knowledge of the plans.
summary_zh: 据《信息报》周一援引知情人士的话报道，特斯拉已告诉员工，它正在准备公开推出 Cyber​​cab，最早将于本月在德克萨斯州奥斯汀推出。

title: SpaceX's biggest investors are finally visible — just as millions more shares unlock: Chart of the Day

title: Tech searches for gains as stocks teeter at the open: AlphaCheck
